a: NASA funding through STScI, no new observing time; no cap on Regular AR or Theory requests (Cycle 34 terms)
dt: Proposals due Apr 1, 2027, 8 pm ET, the same deadline as observing proposals; STScI's Cycle 35 timeline says the call will be released Dec 16, 2026
e: Funding for Hubble archival research and for theory directly relevant to Hubble observing programs, without new observing time, through Hubble's annual call. Anyone may propose, including students and postdocs; only US investigators (US citizens, permanent residents or visa holders employed by a US institution) can be funded.
n: HST Cycle 35 Archival Research and Theory proposals
unv: The Cycle 35 call itself is not released yet; the dates come from STScI's posted Cycle 35 proposal timeline, and the categories and funding rules follow Cycle 34 and could change.
